title: Bussardstraße, Unterhaching
description:
3,5 Zi. Designerwohnung, neu saniert mit großer Terrasse und mit Möglichkeit eine Garage zu mieten für maximal 3 Personen.

This beautiful apartment is quietly and idyllically located in the countryside and yet central. It has just been lovingly restored.

Equipment:
1 hallway
1 wardrobe
1 living room with wooden parquet
1 bedroom with wooden floorboards and four-poster bed
1 children/guest/study room with wooden floorboards
1 white kitchen with stove, oven, refrigerator, freezer, dishwasher,
1 large covered terrace

Location:
Quiet living and close to the city
The apartment is conveniently located near the S-Bahn Fasanengarten, close to Infineon.
Due to the edge of the forest you are surrounded by good fresh air, jogging is a real pleasure.
By car you can reach the center of Munich in 15 minutes, by train you can reach Marienplatz in 20 minutes.
A single garage would be possible to rent. this is lockable.
The apartment has been lovingly completely restored and has been tastefully furnished to a high standard.

Other features:
- First floor
- terrace
- Tiled floor, wooden floorboards
- ISDN connection
- fitted kitchen
 - fully furnished
- bathroom with shower, bathroom with tub, bathroom/WC separate
- suitable for shared flat
- DVB-T, cable connection
- first occupancy, luxurious
- elevator in the house
 
-1 parking space: garage (can be rented for an extra charge of 100 €)

***********

Diese schöne Wohnung liegt ruhig und idyllisch im Grünen und ist dennoch zentral. Sie wurde gerade liebevoll restauriert.

Ausstattung:
1 Flur
1 Garderobe
1 Wohnzimmer mit Holzparkett
1 Esszimmer
1 Schlafzimmer mit Holzdielen und Himmelbett
1 Kinder/Gäste/Arbeitszimmer mit Holzdielen
1 weiße Küche mit Herd, Backofen, Kühlschrank, Gefrierschrank, Geschirrspülmaschine, Waschmaschine
1 große Terrasse überdacht

Lage:
Ruhig wohnen und stadtnah
Die Wohnung liegt verkehrsgünstig an der S-Bahn Fasanengarten, Nähe Infineon.
Durch den Waldrand ist man von guter frischer Luft umgeben, joggen bereitet die wahre Freude.
Man gelangt mit dem Auto in 15 Minuten das Münchner Stadtzentrum, mit der Bahn ist man in 20 Minuten am Marienplatz.
Eine Einzelgarage wäre möglich zu mieten. diese ist abschliessbar und kostet im Monat 100 Euro zusätzlich.
Die Wohnung wurde liebevoll komplett restauriert und wurde geschmackvoll hochwertig eingerichtet.

Weitere Merkmale:
- Erdgeschoss
- Terrasse
- Fliesenboden, Holzdielen
- ISDN-Anschluss
- Einbauküche
 - vollmöbliert
- Bad mit Dusche, Bad mit Wanne, Bad/WC getrennt
- WG-geeignet
- DVB-T, Kabelanschluss
- Erstbezug, luxuriös
- Personenaufzug im Haus
- nur für Nichtraucher
- leider sind Tiere im Haus nicht erlaubt
 
-1  Garage kann gegen einen Aufpreis von 100 € dazu gemietet werden

einmal im Monat kommt die Putzfee mit 4 Stunden für die Reinigung der wohnung. Dieser Service ist im Mietpreis inbegriffen.

title: Von-Stauffenberg-Straße, Unterhaching
description:
The spacious shared room is located in a bright 4-room apartment, which has been recently renovated. While the apartment and furniture are no longer brand new, everything is in excellent condition. 

The apartment is equipped with a shared washing machine, which is available for use between multiple tenants at a cost of €1.50 per wash, by reservation. The windows are fitted with both curtains and blinds, allowing you to adjust the light and privacy as needed.

There is a storage room in the hallway that offers additional space for personal belongings, shared with other flatmates. The kitchen is well-equipped, providing a great space for socializing. It includes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, hob, and basic kitchenware. The apartment also has a large cellar compartment for extra storage.

The rental price includes all utilities as well as fast WLAN.


Location Description for Von Staufenbergstraße 92, Unterhaching, Munich:

The apartment is located in the quiet, well-connected area of Unterhaching, just south of Munich. It’s within walking distance to the Unterhaching S-Bahn station, which provides fast access to central Munich (approx. 20 minutes). Additionally, there are bus stops nearby, offering further convenient public transportation options.

For daily needs, there are several supermarkets (e.g. Edeka, Rewe), cafes, and shops located within walking distance. The area is very residential, providing a calm and green environment, while also being just a short commute away from the hustle and bustle of downtown Munich. The nearby parks and green spaces are perfect for relaxing or outdoor activities.

In terms of amenities, you’ll find a variety of local services such as pharmacies, gyms, and restaurants within a few minutes’ walk. Whether you’re looking for a quiet suburban lifestyle with great transport links or a more active, urban vibe, this location offers the best of both worlds.
As a professional co-living provider, we carefully match tenants to ensure a harmonious living experience. We look forward to hearing from you! :)

title: Grafstraße, Unterhaching
description:
English/German:

Bright, quiet 1-room apartment in the south-east of Munich (Unterhaching), with S-Bahn connection to the city of Munich. The apartment is modern and attractively furnished, fully equipped, has vinyl flooring in wood look (suitable for allergy sufferers), is located on the 2nd floor with elevator and has a balcony with a nice view! 

Pack your bags, move in, arrive!

Living/bedroom/kitchen are visually separated by a room divider, bathroom with tub and toilet, 
small balcony with seating, southeast orientation / morning sun. The apartment has a cellar compartment. A shared laundry room is also located in the house.

Rental exclusively temporary, to 1 person.

- Kitchen with stove/oven, fridge/freezer, kettle, coffee machine etc. Kitchen is new!!
- Crockery and cooking utensils fully provided
- Blinds + curtains for blackout on the window front
- Cable TV, smart flat screen TV, Wi-Fi 
- Washing machine in the communal laundry room in the house
- Bed 140x200 cm
- Living/dining area with armchair, room divider, dining table etc.
- Apartment is suitable for 1 person
- Smoking only on the balcony, no pets
- Vacuum cleaner, ironing board, iron, bed linen, towels provided
- Basic equipment cleaning products available

There are always plenty of parking spaces on the street.
All shops for daily needs, doctors and restaurants are within walking distance. 

Helles, ruhiges 1-Zimmer-Appartement im Südosten von München (Unterhaching), mit S-Bahn-Anbindung in die City von München. Das Apartment ist modern und ansprechend möbliert, voll ausgestattet, verfügt über Vinylboden in Holzoptik (allergikergeeignet), liegt im 2. Obergeschoss mit Aufzug und hat einen Balkon mit Ausblick! 

Koffer packen, einziehen, ankommen!

Wohn/Schlafzimmer/Küche sind durch einen Raumteiler optisch getrennt, Badezimmer mit Wanne und WC, 
kleiner Balkon mit Sitzgelegenheit, Südostausrichtung / Morgensonne. Zu dem Apartment gehört ein Kellerabteil. Eine Gemeinschaftswaschküche befindet sich ebenfalls im Haus.

Vermietung ausschließlich befristet, an 1 Person.

- Küche mit Herd/Backofen, Kühl/Gefrierkombination, Wasserkocher, Kaffeemaschine etc. - die Küche ist neu!!
- Geschirr und Kochutensilien komplett vorhanden
- Jalousien + Vorhänge zur Verdunkelung an der Fensterfront
- Kabelfernsehen, smart Flat TV, W-lan 
- Waschmaschine im Gemeinschaftswaschkeller im Haus
- Bett  140x200 cm
- Wohn-/Essbereich mit Sessel, Raumteiler, Esstisch etc.
- Apartment ist für 1 Person geeignet
- Rauchen nur auf dem Balkon, keine Haustiere
- Staubsauger, Bügelbrett, Bügeleisen, Bettwäsche, Handtücher vorhanden
- Grundausstattung Putzmittel vorhanden

Parkplätze sind auf der Straße immer ausreichend vorhanden.
Alle Geschäfte des täglichen Bedarfs, Ärzte und Restaurants befinden sich fußläufig in der näheren Umgebung.

title: Johann-Strauß-Straße, Unterhaching
description:
We offer you a cozy, fully furnished room in a freshly renovated apartment (5-bed flat share) in Unterhaching near Munich with a fantastic balcony (12.6 sqm) and a breathtaking view over the whole of Munich to the Alps!

- Rent: All-inclusive (incl. utilities) between 700 and 799 €; depending on room 
- Facilities:
o Fully furnished: Bed (mattress+topper, bed linen+pillows, bedspread), desk, desk chair, closet with mirror, bed box, TV
o Shower room (WC, shower) and additional separate WC and washing machine available
o Parking space available, can be rented optionally

The apartment is located in Unterhaching, one of Munich's most sought-after suburbs. Here you can enjoy the perfect mix of city life and relaxation:

- Super transportation links:
o Only 17 minutes by S-Bahn to Marienplatz (S-Bahn frequency: every 10 min)
o S-Bahn (S3) and buses in the immediate vicinity; Unterhaching S-Bahn station 7min walk away, bus 2min
o Fast connection to the A8 and A995 for motorists

- Shopping facilities & leisure:
o Large selection of supermarkets (e.g. REWE, EDEKA, ALDI) and drugstores directly on site
o Weekly market for fresh food
o Numerous cafés, restaurants and small stores for everyday needs
o Leisure facilities:
 Swimming pool and fitness studios
 Many green spaces and parks, ideal for jogging, walking or relaxing
 Sports clubs and a wide range of leisure activities in the area

- Short distances to education & work:
o LMU & TUM (Innendstadt): 30min (Sbahn, U-Bahn)
o Infineon & Intel: 9min (car), 20min (S-Bahn) or 6min (bike)
o Bundeswehr Neubiberg: 12min (car), 20min (bus; 217) or 15min (bike)
o Airbus; 14min (car), 30min (bus) or 20min (bike)
o Siemens: 16min (car) or 20min (bike)
